 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The present application has been filed by the petitioners invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court for quashing the order dated 30.05.2019 passed by the learned Sub-divisional Judicial Magistrate.

Sadar, Sitamarhi in Complaint Case No. C1-1356 of 2018, Tr. No. 3082 of 2021 by which cognizance for the offence under Sections 498A, 323 of the Indian Penal Code has been taken against the petitioners.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.28076 of 2024(2) dt.03-02-2026 petitioner no.1 is the father-in-law and the other petitioners are brothers-in-law of the opposite party no.2.
It has further been submitted that there is a general and omnibus allegation levelled against them.

4. In view of the aforesaid submissions, let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2 through registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process with present and correct address for which requisite etc. must be filed within one week.
